verdict.rationale: Autopilot uses AI to pull feature requests out of raw sources such as call transcripts, support, and sales conversations, which covers decluttering at the capture stage. Surfacing impactful opportunities is evidenced mainly through the MCP server, where an external LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) can dig into top themes and ARR impact across ideas. That means the prioritization half depends on third-party AI tools rather than a documented native capability. Missing for 10: native AI deduplication or merging of raw feedback, built-in AI opportunity ranking or impact scoring, in-depth docs on how Autopilot filters noise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
